note: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, vLLM TP4/EP4 on B200, capture 2 (job 1185, max_cudagraph_capture_size 2048). One order-independent rule set: every position is claimed by at most one operation (checked by subsumptions and disagreements at the fixpoint). Name fragments key the MXFP8 GEMMs by their quant K (the swizzled quant tensor stride), the cuBLAS nvjet tiles by output dtype (tss = fp32: router, compressor; tst = bf16: weights_proj, wk, lm_head), and the anonymous `kernel` launches by exact name plus their successor. Unmapped decisions are listed in manifest.json.
